title: sfc_midori: replication code for 'Assessment of Japan's MIDORI Food System Strategy: A Stock-Flow Consistent Model with Environmental Satellite Accounts'
description: R code, calibration ledger, design notes and run log for a master's thesis (University of Hohenheim, 2026) that evaluates the fertiliser KPI and the organic KPI of Japan's MIDORI Food System Strategy in an environmental stock-flow consistent model with satellite accounts for nitrous oxide, paddy methane and soil organic carbon.
